اصحاممت (form XI)
# اِصْحَامَمْتُ (iṣḥāmamtu) /isˤ.ħaː.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِصْحَامَّ (iṣḥāmma)
# اِصْحَامَمْتَ (iṣḥāmamta) /isˤ.ħaː.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْحَامَّ (iṣḥāmma)
# اِصْحَامَمْتِ (iṣḥāmamti) /isˤ.ħaː.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْحَامَّ (iṣḥāmma)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
